liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Doll** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer's highlight, though played at a rushed pace that they feel does not suit the old ballad; Reviewer loves China Doll emerging out of Space [1][20][22]
- **High Time** (1 review, 1 other source): Listener singles out High Time as sounding sweet on the audience recording; Weir played acoustic guitar on High Time [1][14]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Crowd roar is clearly audible as Jerry begins the first verse of Eyes; Eyes opening the second set is called a treat [15][16]
- **Samba In The Rain** (1 review): Reviewer dislikes Samba in the Rain, along with If the Shoe Fits and Easy Answers, saying they drained energy [19]
- **Jam** (1 other source): A tape flip during the jam after He's Gone lost a few seconds [7]
- **Jerry & drummers** (1 review): Reviewer found the Jerry and drums jam after He's Gone a bit odd [19]
- **Lucy in the Sky With Diamonds** (1 other source): Lucy was missing from John's tape and patched in from shnID 85687 [4]
- **Easy Answers** (1 other source): The first few seconds of Easy Answers are missing because of a tape flip [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ain't No Easy Answers**: rare: 3 archived performances [23]
- **Jerry & drummers**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-11.111986.akg.datbrad.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-10-11.sbd.miller.34564.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 160 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [2]
- **gd1994-10-11.nak300.bleich.LMPP.94370.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 159 min [4]
- **gd1994-10-11.147756.nak300.Boedicker.flac1644**: source not stated; 17 songs; 158 min [7]
- **gd94-10-11.set2-sbd.braverman.17959.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 105 min; rated 2.6/5 by 10 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording top notch; Reviewer agrees the recording is not a soundboard; Reviewer finds the recording low quality, very hissy and bassy [11][16][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was in the crowd at USAir Arena, which he still thinks of as the Cap Centre [11]
- Reviewer says Jerry sounded tired but beautiful, linking this to an injury from a fall [18]
- Reviewer notes this was the last night at the Cap Centre for the year [22]
- Jerry left the stage for a little while during the second-set jam, then returned [1]
- Reviewer, who attended, calls this the best of the three Landover nights, with good energy and strong song choices [11]
- Reviewer rates this among the strongest performances of the Landover 1994 run [19]
- Reviewer considers this the final and weakest night of the three-show run [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-11.111986.akg.datbrad.flac16**: taped by datbrad; transferred by datbrad; source: (OTS) AKG460s/CK8s(PAS)>B-18s>FP-11s>DAP20(16/48) Digital [1]
- **gd1994-10-11.sbd.miller.34564.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> ? -> 3rd Gen Cassette D [2]. Also: Recorded with AKG 460/CK61 microphones to DAT, then transferred to CD; Cassettes supplied by Gary Field; a Nak cassette deck belonging to macdaddy was used, with seamless transition between discs 2 and 3 [2]
- **gd1994-10-11.nak300.bleich.LMPP.94370.flac16**: taped by John Bleich; transferred by Brian Green; Evan K.; source: Nak 300's > D6 [4]. Also: Taped by John on Nak300; transferred and edited by Bgreen, then tracked, flac'ed and packed by Evan; First seeded to www.shnflac.net in September 2008 by the Live Music Preservation Project [4]
- **gd1994-10-11.147756.nak300.Boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Marantz PMD 430 Cassette Deck>Master Cassette Tapes(1st Set Sony UX 90 Minute [7]. Also: Source is a Nak300 recording credited to Boedicker [7]
- **gd94-10-11.set2-sbd.braverman.17959.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ?> C4> CD> SHN via Billy Schools encoded by Peter Braverman [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-10-11 USAir Arena, Landover, MD, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-10-11-usair-arena-landover-md-usa/) [24]
- Poster by Rob Cohn: [Grateful Dead - USAir Arena, Landover (10-11-1994) Photo Print - Bear's Choice Web Shop](https://bearschoice.jp/?pid=103364445) [25]
